## Project

Niramaya AI is a medical document processing and retrieval project. Its repository includes a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL data models, document extraction, chunking, and hybrid retrieval code. Deployment, external service operation, clinical validation, and retrieval quality are unverified.
